name: NA48 Collaboration
notes: No live official NA48 collaboration page was found (the experiment concluded in the mid-2000s); membership fields are left null rather than populated from a paper's author-affiliation list.
Leadership is left empty: person records are owned by another workstream.
Derived field collaboration.experiment_ids is deliberately not written (v0.2 A1).

summary.plain: The international team of physicists who ran the NA48 experiment at CERN from the 1990s to the mid-2000s, studying CP violation in kaon decays.
summary.technical: Completed international collaboration operating the NA48 direct-CP-violation programme (and its NA48/2 continuation) at the CERN SPS ECN3 cavern; no official collaboration page (live or archived) with a headline membership count was found by a source fetched this session, so membership counts are left null rather than computed from author-affiliation lists on physics papers (per the rule that collaboration membership is never inferred from institutional affiliation).
